understanding.goal_understanding: Reach the goal gem tile marked + in every level, while progressing through the BP35 level sequence until the game is won.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Horizontal MOVE_LEFT and MOVE_RIGHT actions cause the player to continue falling automatically in the current gravity direction until landing, hitting a hazard, or reaching the goal. The structured landing previews and corridor scan indicate where each move will end and which columns open passages to new sections. CLICK at a target coordinate interacts with clickable tiles, especially removing breakable x blocks to open a gravity path, and does not advance the rising-platform timer. Landing on u or v spikes ends the attempt; each level allows two attempts of up to 50 turns. UNDO reverses the previous action and can recover from a mistaken click or move.
